Sai  Vihar Pushpa Banglo, Dakan Kotra, Savina, Udaipur, Raj.
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. P.D. Bohra For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukhtiyar Khan, PP  Mr.S.P. Sharma present in person
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 16/04/2024 1.

By way of filing the instant Criminal Misc. Petition, the petitioner has sought relief for quashing of FIR No.95/2023 registered at the Police Station Hathipol, Udaipur for the offence under Sections 420, 406 & 120-B of the IPC 2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor for the State and perused the FIR impugned as also the material available to this Court.
3. A perusal of the FIR revealing commission of the cognizable offence .
There is a clear allegation of swindling the complainant Satya Prakash Sharma as a consequence of which, he incurred huge loss.

The petitioner has neither transferred any property to [2024:RJ-JD:19046] (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-6660/2023] the complainant nor any amount has been re-paid/refunded back.
Thus, no case for quashing of the FIR is made out.
